bio: Before his exile, Tatsulow controlled a vast mafia in the Evernight Basin, and he could threaten even the Old Blood Barons. Revolution cost him much – his wealth, his contacts, his businesses… but his strength is no less than it ever was. Anyone trying to settle a score had better bring an army.
